name: FeWo Biohof Planer
beschreibung:
Perched at over 1,400 metres altitude on a sunny slope in the pristine Defereggen valley, Biohof Planer welcomes guests with genuine East Tyrolean warmth. The cosy apartment features natural materials and panoramas of the High Tauern National Park summits.

The valley is renowned for its allergen-free mountain air, untouched alpine pastures, gentle skiing at St. Jakob, and backcountry ski touring.
kurzbeschreibung: FeWo Biohof Planer in St. Veit in Defereggen offers sustainable organic farmstay holidays in the untouched Defereggen valley.
